newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS - Big turnover in AEX puts, market bearish.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Big turnover in AEX puts, market bearish.

text.p: Business on the European Options Exchange focused on the AEX-index on Wednesday as Dutch share prices fell sharply, leaving investors in a jittery mood.
"Some investors must be very bearish to buy December puts with a strike price of 565 for one guilder," said one dealer.
Business was also guite heavy in the December 585- and 600- puts.
The Dutch share index was lingering at around 605, off just over 17 points, in late afternoon and some dealers said the index could slip to around 590 points.
But, another dealer said he saw some buy orders from big investors, which had left him with a more optimistic expectation on the direction of the market.
